Hydro jetting cleans the line from the inside, so the first question is where the blockage sits. Trotwood's Public Works water and sewer page says the city utility crew maintains a lift station and 30.9 miles of wastewater collection lines, including flushing and clearing main lines. A blockage in the private line to the main is a separate job. Tell us which fixtures are affected before choosing a service.
